verdict.rationale: Lambda publishes a documented REST API, the Lambda Cloud API, for creating and managing cloud resources. A full OpenAPI 3.1 spec is live at cloud.lambda.ai, and a runtime probe confirmed key-gated instance endpoints; a community developer also built an agent-facing CLI and MCP server on top of it. The 404s for the spec under docs.lambda.ai paths don't contradict this, since the spec is served elsewhere. Missing for 10: evidence that the API covers 1-Click Cluster and managed Kubernetes/Slurm operations (1CC reservation is documented through the console), and the documented rate limits (1 req/s) constrain heavy agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Lambda Cloud API provides a set of REST API endpoints you can use to create and manage your Lambda Cloud resources.
You can also launch instances programmatically by using the Lambda Cloud API. For details, see Launch instances
https://cloud.lambda.ai/api/v1/openapi.json serves the full Lambda Cloud API OpenAPI 3.1 spec
